author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.
title: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk

author: DIPAWALI MITRA AND POULAMI ROY
description: Book stalls set up by Left parties saw significant sales increases during Durga Puja amid incidents of vandalism. The CPM stall at Jadavpur 8B bus stand recorded sales of Rs 16 lakh, nearly four times last year's figures. Despite attacks, sales for other Left stalls also increased, evidencing a broader engagement with literature. Politicians from various parties expressed solidarity with the Left stalls amidst ongoing disputes.
title: Amid attacks, sales surge at Kolkata Left bookstalls

author: TNN
description: In her first post on Instagram, Sonia shared a video of her welcoming the first copies of her autobiography “Belonging: A journey of love” which is set to be released on Nov 10. The video showed her holding up the book and then sharing sweets with daughter and MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. “It is a story of love, duty, loss and finding a place to belong. I look forward to sharing it with you,” Sonia wrote on the post.
title: Sonia Gandhi makes Instagram debut, shares first look of her upcoming book

author: DIPAK K DASH
description: Life insurance policies, too, would no longer be accepted as proof. Proposing sweeping changes to the driving licence (DL) regime under Motor Vehicles Rules, the road transport ministry Wednesday issued a draft notification to raise the pass mark for the online safe-driving tutorial assessment from the current 60% to 75%.
title: Govt plans colour-coded driving licence for Indians, foreigners

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: The Union govt has told the SC in its affidavit that margins on hospital consumables can range from 100% to 1,000% or more, highlighting concerns over the high mark-ups patients often face on supplies used during treatment. However, a senior official told TOI that the govt does not have the data needed to assess margins across hospital supplies and determine whether wider controls are warranted.
title: Centre flags data gap, regulatory hurdles in curbing hospital mark-ups

author: TNN
description: India has condemned the continued attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure. “These attacks have unfortunately resulted in civilian deaths and injuries. We convey our heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family and wish speedy recovery to those injured. The Indian embassy in Riyadh...will provide all possible assistance,” said ministry of external affairs (MEA) in a statement. The victim has not been identified by Saudi authorities so far.
title: Indian dies in Saudi airport strike; MEA slams infrastructure attacks

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K V Viswanathan said cases already dealt with by foreign courts were coming before it time and again and their adjudication was not easy as they involved deeply emotional and sensitive issues. It added that the welfare of the child “must be understood in the widest sense, not by money or physical comfort alone”.
title: Don’t blindly follow foreign custody order: Supreme Court

author: RAKESH KUMAR
description: Justice Yashwant Varma’s name still figuring on the list of judges on the HC website had bolstered the view. However, sources said legal opinion, backed by a court verdict, that an HC judge’s resignation comes into effect as soon as he resigns may prevail in what was earlier seen as a legal grey area.
title: Resignation by Justice Yashwant Varma may end Lok Sabha proceedings

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Nestled at 108 Hampton Avenue, this unique property in Goose Creek is now on the market. It boasts three distinct kitchens, creatively themed bedrooms, and a generous indoor pool. Spanning 5,390 square feet, this estate is perfect for multigenerational families or as a lucrative short-term rental option. The outdoor spaces are ideal for entertaining.
title: South Carolina home with 3 kitchens and indoor pool lists for $1.227m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Imagine a dusty car boot sale where a unique necklace fashioned from human hair and whale bone was nearly sold for just £15. Fortunately, it caught the eye of an expert at Ewbank's auction house, revealing its immense worth, which fetched an incredible £99,000 at auction. This story underscores the vital role of appraisals in recognizing hidden treasures that often go unnoticed in clearance sales.
title: Necklace almost priced at £15 for car boot sale later sold for £99,000

author: TNN
description: PM Modi and his Polish counterpart Tusk expressed deepest concern in a joint statement over the war in Ukraine, including its tragic humanitarian consequences and the impact on Global South. In his media statement, Modi assured Tusk that whether it is Ukraine or West Asia, India will continue to support every meaningful effort for peace.
title: Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk

author: TNN
description: PM Modi said he had received acall from Netanyahu during which the leaders reviewed the sustained momentum in bilateral ties and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the partnership. Modi did not mention Netanyahu’s invitation in his post on the conversation. “We exchanged views on developments in West Asia and underscored the urgent need to restore peace and stability in the region,” Modi said on X.
title: In call with Bibi, PM Modi says urgent need to restore West Asia peace

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: In a letter, dated Oct 22, to I&B minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, IMA national president Dr Anilkumar J Nayak sought an impartial review of the promo video for the upcoming film and appropriate corrective measures from its makers. It also called for a ban or other action if justified under applicable law. The letter was also copied to the Union health and home ministries and the chairperson of National Medical Commission.
title: Movie glorifies violence, generalises graft in medical field: IMA

author: TNN
description: Both the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha chairman had rejected previous notices from the opposition, saying their allegations “do not prima facie meet the high constitutional bar for removal proceedings”. Birla noted the process for removal of the chief election commissioner was the same as for removing a Supreme Court judge.
title: Will decide on any notice to remove CEC according to rules: LS Speaker Om Birla

author: SHILPA PHADNIS
description: Google Cloud executives Chris Betz, chief information security officer, and Raluca Ada Popa, head of Gemini Security at Google DeepMind, said PHP and cybersecurity firm Wiz Research disclosed the two vulnerabilities after research that used multiple AI models to identify and help remediate them. Google Cloud said its own infrastructure was not vulnerable, but warned that customers running PHP applications on the platform could be exposed
title: PHP security flaws trigger global scramble; CERT-In flags vulnerabilities

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: The move is to curb cross-border cyber frauds, phishing, digital arrest scams using Indian mobile numbers and enhance telecom cyber security. Apple has updated iOS with a software patch to help detect when an iPhone is operating without a physical SIM card to abide with the rules. It is learnt Signal has not yet responded to govt notices.
title: From Jan 1, WhatsApp, Telegram won’t work without SIM cards, govt issues guidelines

author: TNN
description: First secretary in India’s permanent mission to UN, Raghoo Puri, was responding to a report by Ben Saul, the special rapporteur on the ‘Promotion and Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms while Countering Terrorism’. He said this presented member-states with a fait accompli, an unfortunate situation for an organisation already facing challenges to its legitimacy.
title: MEA calls out UN report for saying Dawood Ibrahim's D-company India-based

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: In an affidavit filed in SC on the issue of capping prices of all medicines and medical consumables, chemicals and fertilisers ministry said that patients have a very low bargaining position with respect to hospitals, resulting in various malpractices. The affidavit noted the irony of India being home to companies making cheap drugs but patients here having to pay way above the manufacturing price, as well as patients being subjected to overcharging by hospitals.
title: Hospitals ‘overcharging’ is a malpractice: Govt to Supreme Court

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Trans man Taylor Winters, 42, and his wife Chloe, 33, are expecting their first child after IVF using his eggs frozen before his transition. Chloe is carrying their baby girl after the couple used a sperm donor to conceive. Following an unsuccessful first attempt, the couple conceived on their second round of IVF in May 2026.
title: Trans man and wife expecting child via IVF using his frozen eggs

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Hawaii coral larvae settled on bacteria-coated concrete, not bare blocks

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: According to a recent report, the Amazon has lost 97 million hectares of primary forest by 2025. Most forest loss is attributed to human activity, particularly land clearing and fires. The disruptions to moisture pathways during dry seasons raise critical concerns for the ecosystem. A strong El Niño expected in late 2026 could exacerbate these issues and increase fire risks.
title: Amazon lost 32.2m acres of primary forest from 2022 to 2025: Study

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The successful eradication of invasive rodents in 2005 has greatly influenced seabird populations on Surprise Island. Researchers closely monitored seven seabird species to document their recovery post-eradication. While some species thrived quickly, others needed more extended observation to show signs of improvement. Notably, noddies saw a significant increase in breeding pairs, whereas red-footed boobies showed a more gradual recovery.
title: Pacific island seabird populations rose 2 to 10 times after rats were removed

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Police and fire department personnel were working to rescue people and provide temporary shelter to those who had lost their homes. Rescue teams were also putting up tents to accommodate residents displaced by the earthquake. According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the earthquake occurred at 10.33 pm local time.
title: 16 killed, 32 injured in magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet; rescue ops under way

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A retired decorator has become an overnight millionaire after his Pokemon card collection, stored in his attic for 15 years, fetched £1.56 million at auction. The collector, who bought complete sets for as little as £300, discovered their value after reading a newspaper report. A rare Charizard set alone achieved a hammer price of £100,000.
title: Retired decorator's £300 Pokemon cards sell for £1.56M after 15 years

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Tom Brady collected $170,000 for a speaking gig at Salem State University, generously donating the entire sum to charity. He allocated $50,000 to Best Buddies and distributed the remaining funds to various other organizations. With approximately 4,000 attendees present, ticket sales effectively covered his speaking fee. However, the event was notable for Brady facing questions about the NFL's Deflategate saga. The university reported a financial profit from hosting the event.
title: Tom Brady donated $170,000 Salem State speaking fee to charities in 2015

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2018, Vanessa Hudgens acquired a charming historic residence in Los Angeles from Gary Oldman for almost $5 million. She renovated and redesigned the space, ultimately selling it to Ronan Farrow and Jon Lovett in February 2022 for an impressive $6.725 million. The 1922-built house, fondly known as Little DeMille, boasted rich heritage, beautiful gardens, and artistic enhancements by Hudgens, showcasing her flair for style.
title: Vanessa Hudgens bought Gary Oldman's LA home for nearly $5m, sold for $6.7m

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: The iconic Ellis Building, erected in 1922, is set to undergo a transformation into a chic boutique hotel, managed by Aperture Hotels and affiliated with Marriott's Tribute Portfolio. This revitalization aims to breathe new life into the historic space, following previous redevelopment failures. The project promises about 95 to 105 stylish guest rooms, complemented by a modern restaurant and bar, aligning with similar projects in downtown Phoenix.
title: Phoenix office tower sold for $10.3m, set to become 100-room Marriott hotel

author: SANJAY KHAJURIA
description: In his order on Wednesday, principal sessions judge Ramban Ajay Kumar Gupta rejected defence arguments that the attack had taken place more than two decades ago when Sharief was young, his long incarceration and possibility of rehabilitation. Besides the life sentences, the court imposed two separate terms of 10 years on Sharief under various sections pertaining to murder and arms act offences.
title: 21 years on, double life term for Jammu terror attack that killed baby, 2 others

author: BHARTI JAIN AND NASEER GANAI
description: Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed.
title: Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Andy Murray has officially retired from professional tennis and, in doing so, has opened a new chapter in his life, and the former world No 1 will have more time to spend with his wife Kim Sears and their four children. From parenting and family routines to their shared business interests at Cromlix, the couple are handling life outside the demands of professional tennis while keeping family at the center.
title: Murray’s wife Kim Sears, four children: Inside his family life after retirement

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Palantir Technologies highlights the necessary reliance on US technology for European countries in the short term. Louis Mosley addressed challenges, including Europe’s reliance on China for industrial components needed for defense capabilities. As European nations consider reducing foreign technology use, Palantir faces scrutiny from some countries like France and the UK. Nonetheless, Mosley noted strong engagement in markets like Ukraine, where practical needs take precedence.
title: Palantir exec to Europe: You need China for drones and US tech for now

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Bryant Gingerich and his wife Amy turned a sprawling 34-acre land into a thriving hospitality destination known as Dunlap Hollow. This charming getaway features an array of unique accommodations, including a quaint cottage, an A-frame, and an adventurous cave stay. By leveraging social media marketing, they attracted a steady stream of guests, leading to impressive profits.
title: Ohio man's rentals on 34 acres grossed over $700,000, netted $350,000

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Almost ten years post the controversial Roe 8 highway initiative, Western Australia is witnessing a promising wave of ecological recovery. Recent studies have reported a remarkable resurgence of local wildlife and native plant life. Rehabilitation efforts, which have culminated in planting over 280,000 seedlings, are welcoming back species such as Carnaby’s black cockatoos.
title: Australia restores 200,000 plants to wetlands cleared for cancelled highway

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: BrahMos Aerospace is set to develop the next-generation BrahMos-NG missile by 2027-28. The company aims to strengthen its supply chain and production capacity to meet increasing demand. Interest from foreign militaries in air-launched versions of BrahMos is growing. A 1,500-km-range variant is also under exploration but remains at a conceptual stage. Recent contracts with the Indian Navy are expected to boost domestic manufacturing and participation from local industries.
title: BrahMos goes global, eyes next-gen missile by 2028; 1,500-km strike variant on radar

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for stronger global institutions during his address at the NDTV World Summit. He argued that the current global system struggles to address new challenges, particularly in international relations. Modi also criticized Congress leadership for failing to effectively launch their leader, calling it a burden on the party. Furthermore, he highlighted India's role in international cooperation, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic.
title: PM Modi calls for stronger global institutions; takes ‘failed product’ jab at Cong

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Dave Billings, a fabricator from Derbyshire, has dedicated 11 years to creating an underground garden project. His construction includes two bunkers connected by a long passage, which was inspired by World War II escape tunnels. Billings designed a lift disguised as a beer keg to facilitate drink delivery underground. He plans to connect the bunkers to his home through a concealed entrance leading to an old well.
title: UK man builds WWII-style bunker under garden with 35ft tunnel and beer lift

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Garrett Brown launched Cameron Ranch Glamping on a picturesque 10-acre plot in Houston, beginning with a minimal budget. He cleverly applied land hacking methods that streamlined utility connections while steering clear of complicated planning processes. The business flourished initially with a geodome, later evolving through zero-cost revenue-sharing arrangements. Rather than relying on third-party bookings, he focused on direct guest engagement, chronicling his experiences in his book, The Glamping Investor.
title: Texas man put $12,000 down on 10 acres; glamping grosses over $100,000 yearly

author: AASHISH SAXENA
title: CEC impeachment: Birla says fresh motion will be examined as per rules

author: ANANYA DASGUPTA
description: As Trump blames France’s unrest on immigration and urges Macron to close borders, expert warns law-abiding Indians could get caught in the crossfire
title: Indian diaspora could pay price for West’s immigration backlash, warns Sushant Sareen

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
title: Brookline mansion asks $34m, could beat Tom Brady's $32.5m home sale

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Texas woman whose home was auctioned for $20,000 in 2018 over an unrelated debt has been allowed to continue challenging the sale. Francine Lee Lankford claims the property was her permanent home and legally protected from such a sale. On October 21, 2026, an appeals court ruled that her claim required further examination, but did not restore her ownership.
title: Texas woman can challenge $20,000 home auction over an unrelated debt

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Since the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in 2011, Libya has been trapped in a cycle of political strife and disunity. Although a UN-backed agreement was reached with hopes of conducting elections, various administrations maintain control over separate regions. By April 2026, a unified national budget was achieved, yet obstacles to effective implementation loom large.
title: Civil war & terror: Why Libya is still broken 15 yrs after Gaddafi's bloody end

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.0 hits Tibet

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
title: Sundar the Sailor: Google nixes Trump’s search to name an ocean after himself

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a significant auction event, a first edition of Isaac Newton's *Philosophiæ naturalis principia mathematica* garnered an impressive US$576,000. This pivotal work introduced revolutionary concepts of motion and gravity through mathematical frameworks. With ties to distinguished scholars like the Kennet family and the vital endorsement from Edmond Halley, Newton's insights continue to resonate in disciplines such as engineering and astronomy, shaping modern scientific thought.
title: Newton's 1687 book on gravity, funded by Halley, sold for Rs 5.49 crore

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Connecticut wool mill that closed in 2013, leaving 85 workers jobless, has been revived by former investment banker Jacob Harrison Long. He bought the 475,000-square-foot factory in 2014 despite having no manufacturing experience. Twelve years later, the mill employs about 50 people and supplies fabric for US military uniforms. Long now hopes to expand textile manufacturing across New England.
title: Connecticut wool mill that lost 85 jobs now employs 50, makes military fabric

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Ralf Schumacher highlighted the issues young drivers face in Formula 1 due to the prolonged careers of veteran racers. He noted that older drivers like Fernando Alonso and Lewis Hamilton are still competitive, which affects opportunities for rising stars. Schumacher stated that if veterans continue racing into their 40s, it may be necessary to reassess the relevance of Formula 2.
title: Ralf Schumacher says Lewis Hamilton and Fernando Alonso block young F1 drivers

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: PM Modi, Poland's Tusk bat for deeper ties in defence & space; what was discussed

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Joe Root achieved a significant milestone by becoming the first English batter to surpass 8,000 runs in ODIs. This achievement occurred during a match against Sri Lanka in the Pakistan ODI Tri-Series. Root scored 69 runs off 66 balls and has reached a career total of 8,005 runs in 197 matches. His records include 20 centuries and 49 half-centuries, highlighting his batting prowess.
title: Joe Root creates history! Becomes 1st England batter to cross 8,000-run mark in ODIs

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In response to escalating unrest, French President Emmanuel Macron unveiled plans to prohibit unauthorized protests while ramping up security measures. Following extensive riots and vandalism, authorities brace for further gatherings this weekend. Trade unions and recognized groups will be directed to alternative protest paths to mitigate potential damage, with the initial disturbances rooted in student protests spurring broader demonstrations against rising living costs, just ahead of France's upcoming presidential election.
title: France unrest: Macron vows ban on 'illegitimate' protests in coming days

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: When Jessica Conwell confronted the daunting challenge of triple-negative breast cancer, her husband Matt leaned on his gaming community for support. This passionate group rallied together, spearheading fundraising activities that amassed a remarkable $55,000 in their inaugural event. Inspired by early success, they continued their efforts, ultimately raising over $1 million for critical cancer research.
title: 300 gamers raise $1m for cancer research after Oregon woman’s diagnosis

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Barbara Corcoran outbid herself twice, turned NYC penthouse into 'beach house'

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: After an extensive two-year renovation, the Hyde Park Gardens duplex in London stands elegantly restored. Spanning 4,071 square feet, the lavish residence boasts three bedrooms and bathrooms, complemented by a private terrace overlooking four acres of communal greens. Available for £11.5 million, it’s perfect for those craving luxury and convenience, with nearby attractions including Connaught Village and accessible transport at Lancaster Gate and Paddington stations.
title: London duplex in building once home to Keira Knightley lists for £11.5m

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Chasing 226, India got off to a flying start but lost their way in the middle overs before captain Shreyas Iyer and Naman Dhir helped them cross the finish line with two balls to spare.
title: IND vs NZ: Samson special helps India pull off highest successful chase in T20Is

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Kansas City Current's value increased by 18 percent from $275 million to $325 million in just a year. This valuation places the team second in the National Women's Soccer League, trailing only Angel City FC. The growth in value reflects the stability of the league and solid revenue generation capabilities. Meanwhile, the club continues to work on improving its on-field performance after winning the 2025 Shield.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' soccer club value jumps from $275M to $325M

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Since October 2025, NBA superstar Giannis Antetokounmpo has strategically invested approximately $70 million in various real estate ventures. His family's company, Ante, has facilitated several significant purchases, including apartment complexes in Wisconsin, Brooklyn, and Chicago. Notably, he recently acquired a lavish $13.5 million mansion in Pinecrest, Florida, after joining the Miami Heat. These investments reflect Antetokounmpo's commitment to expanding his financial portfolio beyond basketball income.
title: Giannis Antetokounmpo reportedly invested $70 million in real estate in 2025

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The International Union for Conservation of Nature recently highlighted the alarming vulnerability of coral reefs, predicting that by 2075, nearly all shallow-water coral systems may collapse due to rising ocean temperatures. This impending crisis threatens not only marine biodiversity but also the local communities that depend on these ecosystems for their livelihoods.
title: Marine life on the brink? 96% of coral reefs could face collapse by 2075

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Seven oil tankers sustained damage in the Strait of Hormuz as a result of attacks and naval mines. Four of the tankers reportedly caught fire while transferring oil, creating significant challenges. Iranian authorities have warned of potential targeting of US bases if the situation escalates.
title: Iran claims 7 oil tankers damaged in Hormuz, warns strikes if US helps passage

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India showcased an extraordinary performance at the Asian Para Games 2026, clinching 26 medals and securing a commendable fourth place overall. With a breathtaking total of 88 medals, including 21 gold, the day was especially memorable for armless archer Sheetal Devi, who bagged two golds in quick succession. Para-athletics was pivotal in this achievement, propelling India past South Korea in the medal standings.
title: Asian Para Games: Where India stands in medal tally after best day with 7 golds

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Mohammad Irfaj, a 22-year-old migrant labourer from Bihar, allegedly murdered his 25-year-old wife Ruksana over infidelity suspicions. The couple’s relationship had deteriorated, leading to frequent quarrels about her phone conversations. On October 10, Irfaj killed Ruksana with a stone and concealed her body in a stormwater drain. Police discovered her body three days later and identified her after public inquiries.
title: Bengaluru horror: Man kills wife, steals motorcycle to dump body in drain Do

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Netanyahu invites PM Modi to light Independence Day torch, hails decades-old ties

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Chasing 226, Abhishek faced his first delivery off the final ball of the first over and sent Matt Henry over the cover boundary for a six.
title: Abhishek Sharma scripts history, sets unique six-hitting record in New Zealand T20I

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Shailesh cleared 1.89m to set a new Asian Para Games record, breaking the previous mark of 1.80m set by India's Sharad Kumar at the 2014 edition in Incheon, South Korea.
title: India sweep men's high jump T63; claim gold, silver, bronze at Asian Para Games

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Akhilesh Yadav met Azam Khan in Rampur district jail as the Samajwadi Party prepares for upcoming elections. Yadav accused the BJP government of targeting Khan's family with false cases and political vendetta. During their meeting, they discussed strategies for all 403 Assembly constituencies, gathering input from alliance partners. The SP leader emphasized the importance of justice and fairness in Rampur while planning to fulfill Khan's vision for education.
title: 'No political family faced as much injustice': Akhilesh meets jailed Azam Khan

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: Kashif Minhas once gave up his own cricketing ambitions at his father's insistence. Today, the Multan-based businessman watches his sons Arafat and Sameer represent Pakistan, capturing their journeys through his lens while hoping they will fulfil his dream of winning an ICC trophy for the country.
title: One frame at a time! Story of Multan's Minhas brothers through their father's lens

author: GOKUL ANKARI
title: Indian-origin man, 24, killed in Canada crash days after getting PR approval

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Silence in romantic relationships can signal comfort or discomfort based on personal communication styles and emotional needs. The 2024 study revealed that chosen silence often indicates emotional security and closeness. Alternatively, silence resulting from anxiety or hostility may lead to misunderstandings and emotional distance. Understanding each other's preferences regarding conversation and quiet time can strengthen relationships. Ultimately, intimacy is shaped by both meaningful conversations and moments of peaceful silence.
title: Why some couples are comfortable with silence, according to psychology

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Courtney Adeleye made a remarkable shift from nursing to entrepreneurship by founding The Mane Choice, a haircare brand that achieved impressive success. Initially starting with a few products, the overwhelming demand prompted the addition of supplements, accelerating the brand's growth. Ultimately, The Mane Choice surpassed $100 million in annual sales, culminating in its acquisition for $61.5 million in 2019.
title: US nurse started haircare brand with $500; sales hit $100m in six years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In the year 1926, Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky revolutionized domestic design by creating the Frankfurt Kitchen, aimed at maximizing cooking efficiency for urban dwellers. While around 10,000 of these iconic kitchens were initially integrated into Frankfurt residences, many have since succumbed to renovations. Today, preservationists are dedicated to conserving the remaining kitchens, adapting them with modern appliances while respecting their historical integrity.
title: Frankfurt’s fitted kitchens turn 100; volunteers save parts from about 50

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Germany has informed Boeing it will not buy the MQ-28 Ghost Bat drone as it adjusts its plans. The country is looking to acquire F-35 fighter jets while delaying its uncrewed combat aircraft program to early 2030s. Other companies are emerging as competitors, offering alternative drone solutions by 2029. This shift reflects ongoing discussions on military procurement and strategic autonomy amid increasing global security concerns.
title: Did strategic mistrust prompt Germany to pull out of Boeing's Ghost Bat deal

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Russia is reviewing the invitation for President Vladimir Putin to attend the upcoming G20 summit in December. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov indicated that no final decision has been made yet. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced Putin's potential attendance could facilitate discussions with various world leaders. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy mentioned the possibility of a trilateral meeting involving Ukraine, Russia, and the United States.
title: Russia to review Trump invitation to Putin for G20 summit, possible talks on Ukraine

author: AASHISH VASHISTHA
title: US restaurant that offered free meals in protest against ICE to shut down permanently

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: ‘No permission needed to hoist national flag’: Neha Bora tells Delhi HC

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A years-long dispute between neighbours in Michigan over flooding and water flowing across their properties resulted in both sides receiving compensation. A jury awarded $85,000 to William Michael Coan and Cindy Plant and $91,250 to Robert Ercolani. On October 20, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals upheld both awards and an independent drainage plan intended to address the flooding.
title: Michigan court upholds $85,000 and $91,250 awards in neighbours' water feud

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple has introduced a purchase cap that limits online customers to two iPhones per transaction. This rule applies to all iPhone models currently available on the official website. Buyers can mix and match two different devices or purchase two units of the same model. Attempts to add a third phone trigger an explicit warning from the checkout system. This limitation aims to prevent bulk purchases by resellers and scalpers.
title: Can a customer buy more than two iPhones at one time: What Apple Store 'warning' says

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Minnesota, a conflict brewed between two couples over a shared driveway and the removal of a tree. The Stahleys performed maintenance on the Rubys' land without consent, leading to a legal battle. Ultimately, the court awarded the Rubys $27,000, with $20,000 for invasion of privacy. However, the appeals court overturned the privacy ruling, necessitating further proceedings and adjusting the damages for tree removal.
title: Minnesota court reverses $20,000 privacy award in driveway camera feud

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: 'Against policy': Bikaner House on removal of photos from Raihan Vadra exhibition

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: ‘Not change regime, but break country’: BJP says Cong colluding with foreign powers

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Political tensions have escalated following the removal of photographs from Raihan Vadra's exhibition at Bikaner House. BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia criticized the Gandhi family for allegedly promoting Raihan for political ambitions. Raihan Vadra expressed concerns about censorship and the impact on artistic expression following the objections from the venue management. Both Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and Robert Vadra have expressed their support for Raihan in this matter.
title: ‘Rahul Gandhi, Raihan Vadra’: BJP takes 'launch' jibe as photo exhibition row escalates

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: French health authorities reported the emergence of the Shamonda virus in a human for the first time. This case involved a severely immunocompromised patient who tragically passed away in Lyon. Investigations suggest the virus was contracted through an insect bite, likely from the Culicoides midge. Although the Shamonda virus has been prevalent in livestock, no general health risk has currently been identified.
title: Shamonda virus detected in human for first time in France; patient dies

title: Atlanta home donated in 1926 became 300,000-sq-ft museum 100 years later

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI

title: First time in history! India bowlers make unwanted record as New Zealand run riot

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Australia's Ghost Shark submarine has impressively demonstrated its ability to launch aerial drones for military applications. Capable of deploying various payloads, from sea mines to logistical support, this platform significantly enhances operational flexibility. Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy emphasized that the initiative is designed to refine autonomous underwater combat strategies, with advanced communication systems ensuring smooth coordination of drone operations.
title: In a first, Australia's Ghost Shark submarine turns into aerial drone launchpad

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Florida appeals court has upheld the rejection of a young girl's claim to a deceased man's house, despite his having named her in his will. The dispute involved a 2017 sperm donor agreement between Melissa Azrack and Malcolm Dorman. The appeal failed because Azrack did not challenge the lower court's finding that the property was not protected homestead property.
title: Florida girl named in sperm donor's will loses claim to his house

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Saying yes to others' requests can be a common pattern for people-pleasers, leading to stress and overcommitment. This habit stems from a fear of disappointing others, which can make saying no feel uncomfortable. Continued agreement may cause emotional exhaustion and hinder personal relationships. Effective strategies for setting boundaries include pausing before answering requests and practicing refusal in low-pressure situations.
title: Why some people struggle to say no even when exhausted, according to psychology

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A stunning 1896 edition of 'The Works of Geoffrey Chaucer' has recently fetched around Rs 2.68 crore at auction. Known as the Kelmscott Chaucer, this edition showcases exquisite craftsmanship and features the original white pigskin binding crafted by William Morris. With only about 50 deluxe copies ever bound, this book's rarity and artistic illustrations by Edward Burne-Jones continue to captivate collectors, emphasizing the allure of beautifully crafted literary works.
title: Rare 1896 Chaucer book with 87 woodcuts sold for Rs 2.68 crore

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Sofía Vergara has officially sold her stunning Tuscan-style estate in Beverly Hills for $13.7 million in April 2024. Initially listed at $19.6 million in July 2022, after significant renovations, the price was reduced. Vergara, who acquired the property in 2014 for $10.6 million with Joe Manganiello, achieved a $3.1 million profit before expenses, boasting seven bedrooms, 11 bathrooms, and luxurious amenities throughout.
title: Sofía Vergara's Beverly Hills villa listed for $19.6m, sold for $13.7m

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Top US banks, including Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Chase, are implementing restrictions on third-party AI access amid security worries. These institutions fear that unverified AI agents could potentially gain unauthorized access to customer accounts and conduct transactions autonomously. Some banks are open to allowing read-only permissions, but they remain vigilant against possible financial risks.
title: Rogue AI? US banks sound alarm over unauthorised access by 'agents'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A recent ruling by an appeals court has overturned a foreclosure decision related to a property in Babylon, New York. The court determined that Bank of America did not give the borrower adequate notice prior to starting foreclosure procedures and failed to show that it had the necessary standing in the case. Consequently, the court rejected the bank's request for a summary judgment against the estate of Alice McNamara.
title: New York court overturns foreclosure sale order in $400,000 mortgage row

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel has refuted allegations that President Donald Trump interrupted a military mission planned against Iran. A Financial Times article suggested that Israel had intentions for airstrikes on Iran’s nuclear facilities, which were ultimately dropped due to Trump's disapproval, influenced by worries regarding economic fallout before the midterm elections, particularly concerning fuel prices.

author: AADYA JHA
description: Delhi-NCR has launched GRAP Stage 1 to combat the rising air pollution levels and protect health standards. The initiative focuses on controlling dust, limiting specific fuel types, and tightening regulatory enforcement. Health experts stress the importance of immediate intervention to guard vulnerable populations against the health implications of poor air quality. Citizens are urged to adopt personal safety measures during smoggy days.
title: Delhi-NCR pollution: How GRAP Stage 1 curbs can protect your heart and lungs

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk visited India to strengthen bilateral cooperation between India and Poland. He highlighted the absence of conflicts of interest and shared values between the two nations. Both leaders discussed expanding economic opportunities through the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement. Tusk emphasized the positive economic developments achieved by Poland and India over the last 35 years.
title: 'Beacon of hope': Polish PM Tusk hails ties with India, calls PM Modi a 'friend'

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Praveen Kumar won the men’s high jump T44/64 gold medal at the Asian Para Games in Japan. He accomplished this while dealing with a hip injury and battling fever, cold, and cough. Despite these challenges, he cleared 2.05m, setting a new Games record. His previous record was 1.95m in the T44 category. Praveen aims to defend his Paralympic title at the next Los Angeles Games.
title: Viral fever, vomiting: How Praveen Kumar fought back to win Asian Para Games gold

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: This week, United Airlines aims to have Starlink on more than half of its flights, looking to fully implement the service across its fleet by the end of the following year. CEO Scott Kirby believes this partnership offers a distinct edge in attracting new passengers, especially as rising fuel costs weigh on profits amidst ongoing geopolitical issues.
title: United Airlines CEO says Starlink is helping win customers; Musk responds

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A 14-year-old student from Williamsburg, Virginia, has become one of 30 finalists in a national science competition after developing a mathematical model to improve earthquake sensor placement. Isabel Rossi's six-month research project showed that adding just five sensors could increase simulated detection coverage by 16.7%. She used earthquake records from California and mathematical methods to identify better sensor locations.
title: Virginia teen's model improves simulated earthquake sensor coverage by 16.7%

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Pvt. Joseph E. Boyd, who went missing in action at just 17 during the Korean War, has finally been identified decades later. His remains, previously known as Unknown X-1642, have been matched to his identity through advanced forensic techniques, including DNA testing. A dignified burial ceremony is set for October 21, 2026, in Owings Mills, Maryland, underscoring the ongoing commitment to honor missing service members from historical conflicts.
title: US soldier killed at 17 in Korean War identified after 75 years, to be buried

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Meta Platforms reported a net income of $9.86 billion in Q3 2026, tripling from the previous year. Overall revenue increased to $64.60 billion, primarily driven by higher advertising earnings. However, operating income declined due to a significant legal charge linked to teen mental health litigation. The company plans to invest heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure to support future revenue growth.
title: Meta Q3 results: Net income jumps 264% to $9.86 bn, but legal charge limit profits

title: Indian national among 2 killed in attack on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In an alarming incident at Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinic in Bengaluru, a woman suffered severe second-degree burns during a laser hair removal treatment. Despite her intense pain, the technician minimized her discomfort, labeling it as normal. Subsequent medical examinations validated her injuries. The district consumer commission held the clinic accountable for inadequate service and mandated compensation, including a refund and damages for her injuries and emotional distress.
title: Facial laser session leaves woman with burns; consumer panel orders Rs 1.11 lakh payout

title: CJP leaders seek more time to appear before Delhi Police crime branch

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The excitement for Diljit Dosanjh’s concert in Delhi has been dashed after the police denied permission for the event at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium. Fans are left disappointed as the festive season approaches, with security concerns and law and order issues influencing this decision. Organizers are now faced with the challenge of possibly seeking new permits or rescheduling the concert, marking a setback for the Aura India Tour.
title: Security concerns: Delhi Police deny permission for Diljit Dosanjh's Oct 30 concert

title: Russia targets European firms, largely spares US businesses as Putin-Trump ties warm

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Tata Sons and Tata Trusts are actively evaluating their insurance policies in light of recent legal disputes. This exploration aims to ascertain the level of protection they have against potential lawsuits and legal expenses. The tension rose significantly following a contentious board meeting held on September 17, which discussed the organization's strategic vision.
title: Tata Sons vs Tata Trusts: Both sides explore insurance cover as legal battle looms

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: PHP2Shell, a critical AI-discovered flaw in PHP, the software behind most websites, has forced governments, Wikipedia, hospitals and universities to take sites offline. The decade-old PHP vulnerability lets hackers take over web servers without a password, with millions of attacks logged within hours. Here's what PHP2Shell is, how it works, who is at risk, and what users and  website owners should do right now.
title: PHP2Shell: Govts on high alert over critical website flaw; what users should know

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A study of oyster reef restoration in China's Bohai Bay has found encouraging signs of marine habitat recovery between 2022 and 2026. By March 2026, artificial reefs supported an average of 286 oysters per square metre, while suspended particles in the water had declined by approximately 62%. Published in Frontiers in Marine Science, the study also recorded an increase in seabed animals. However, researchers said further monitoring was needed to establish the project's long-term effectiveness.
title: China's restored reefs hold 286 oysters per sq m; particles down 62%

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A blackstone sculpture of Vishnu, dating to the 11th or 12th century, sold for £635,000 at Christie’s auction. The sculpture was previously part of a Swiss collection and first sold in March 1973. Over the years, the artwork maintained its significance and desirability among collectors. In June 2026, it was auctioned again as part of a collection focusing on South Asian art.
title: Pala-era Vishnu sculpture sold for Rs 8.16 crore, over 9 times estimate

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Indian para-archer Sheetal Devi achieved remarkable success by winning two gold medals at the Asian Para Games. She defended her individual title by defeating Singapore's Alim Nur Syahidah in a tight match. Earlier, Sheetal partnered with Toman Kumar to secure gold in the mixed team event. She also won a silver medal in women's compound doubles alongside Payal Nag.
title: Sheetal Devi strikes double gold again! Repeats 2023 Asian Para Games feat in 2026

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: Facing significant backlash, social media influencer Amir Shokeen publicly apologized for a racially abusive video. Directed towards the people of Tripura and its chief minister, his apology sought to address the hurt caused. The incident has sparked an investigation by the Delhi Police's IFSO unit, prompted by complaints from the Tripura Students Forum Delhi, with political leaders Kiren Rijiju and Manik Saha calling for legal action.
title: ‘It was scripted, a joke’: Delhi influencer apologises over racial abuse of Tripura youth

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An 86-year-old man from Mineral Wells, Texas, has been building a 62-foot steel boat since 1987. After three visitors discovered his ambition, they launched a crowdfunding campaign to support the project. More than $41,000 has been raised towards completing the boat and moving it to a launch site. The remaining work on the vessel is expected to require about $50,000 in funding.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Raihan Vadra's photography exhibition, No Idea Is Fine, allegedly faced turmoil at Bikaner House when management objected hours before its start, claiming venue policy violations. While Vadra proposed removing select images, the officials demanded the removal of all 70 photographs, including those depicting the Indian national flag. This sparked outrage among Congress members, igniting debates about censorship and the value of artistic freedom.

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Preeti Pal dedicated her second silver medal at the Asian Para Games to training partner Chirag Tyagi, who was shot dead in May. Remembering him as a younger brother, Preeti said he dreamed of winning medals for India. Alongside Simran Sharma, she continues to support Chirag’s family, while honouring his memory through her achievements on the track.
title: 'Told he was murdered by a fellow athlete': Preeti recalls losing training partner

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Tesla generated $1.53 billion in free cash flow in the third quarter, which exceeded market expectations. The company's capital expenditure forecast for 2026 was cut to approximately $20 billion from over $25 billion. Tesla's revenue was flat compared to the previous year but still surpassed estimates, while net income fell 43%. Demand for electric vehicles rose significantly as Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the quarter.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Sonia Gandhi has joined Instagram to share the first look of her upcoming memoir titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'. The memoir will be released internationally on November 10 and recounts her personal journey from Italy to India. It includes reflections on her relationship with Rajiv Gandhi and family tragedies. Due to a publishing dispute in India, HarperCollins India will now publish the domestic edition.
title: ‘Finding a place to belong’: Sonia Gandhi makes Insta debut, shares first look of memoir

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Defence minister Rajnath Singh is set to release the new land warfare doctrine during the Army Commanders' Conference. This doctrine aims to provide a framework for adapting to the evolving nature of warfare. It will address operations across conventional and emerging domains such as cyber and electronic warfare. The updated strategies will incorporate lessons from recent conflicts involving precision strikes and advanced technology.
title: Army to unveil new land warfare doctrine: What may change and why it matters

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Thanks to a private sponsor, the House of Marcus Fabius Rufus in Pompeii is set for restoration, with a portion expected to welcome guided groups by this Christmas. The renovation focuses on fresco restoration and improved visitor access, addressing the extensive damage the site suffered since its closure in 1980 due to a volcanic eruption.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Megan Schutt has received a two-match suspension due to her failure to adhere to prescription medication protocols. This situation arose outside competitive play and did not involve performance enhancement. As a result, she will be absent from Australia's final T20I against New Zealand and the WBBL opener for the Adelaide Strikers. Schutt has acknowledged the consequences and expressed her regret, while Cricket Australia remains supportive and emphasises player accountability.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: American actress Mariska Hargitay helped support a project to test 11,341 sexual assault evidence kits discovered in a Detroit police warehouse in 2009. The kits had remained untested for years, with cases dating back to 1984. Led by Wayne County Prosecutor Kym Worthy, the initiative had secured 263 convictions by April 2025, with investigations continuing across the United States.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

author: AHMED ALI
description: Following the alarming shooting incident involving Tiger Shroff, authorities have apprehended multiple suspects. Investigations revealed a nearby location in Mumbai where these individuals honed their shooting skills. The police are now exploring potential ties between the arrested parties and the incident itself. Furthermore, an audio recording containing a threatening message aimed at Shroff is set to undergo voice verification analysis as part of this thorough investigation.

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: From securing international teams to managing logistics, sponsorships and ticket sales, the recent high-profile international football matches that brought Panama, Brazil and Uruguay to India are expensive propositions. The promoter explains why commercial returns are not always guaranteed and why government backing could be crucial to building the market.
title: Decoding the business of bringing Brazil, Uruguay, Panama to India for football friendlies

author: TOI Education
description: ICAI CA Inter September 2026 result: ICAI has declared the CA Intermediate September 2026 results on October 22. Candidates can check their scores and access the merit list through caresults.icai.org using their six-digit roll number and registration number. The results portal also provides access to the Intermediate unit examination result. May 2026 pass rates are included for comparison, while September session statistics should be confirmed through official announcements. Candidates should review their marks and check ICAI notices for verification procedures and subsequent course requirements.

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: Himachal Pradesh state consumer commission upheld a decision directing Shri Ganesh Jewellers to refund Rs 1 lakh. Customer M R Chauhan made an advance payment for a gold chain that was never delivered. Despite repeated requests and a police complaint, the jeweller failed to return the money. The commission awarded compensation of Rs 20,000 for mental harassment and Rs 10,000 for litigation costs.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Alekha Goldberg from California has distinguished herself as a finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge. Her innovative research focuses on the neuroprotective properties of methylene blue for traumatic brain injury, utilizing fruit flies in her experiments. The results show enhanced climbing ability and survival rates post-injury.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Two decommissioned Dornier 228 aircraft are submerged near Kudagiri Island to create a diving attraction. Conservation teams are working to establish an artificial reef by attaching coral fragments to underwater frames. The project aims to combine marine tourism with aviation history while promoting coral growth. Various organizations are collaborating to monitor the ecological impact of this initiative.

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The Indian Rupee fell by 12 paise, settling at 94.50 against the US dollar, driven primarily by surging crude oil prices. However, the currency found some respite from a weaker dollar and declining US treasury yields. Local stock market volatility and climbing oil costs further pressured the rupee. Notably, foreign institutional investors recently bought Rs 1,022.32 crore in equities.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour’s marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers’ pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit.

description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was interrupted by protesters during his keynote at the GTC conference in Berlin. author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Anand Mahindra reminisced about his filmmaking experiences in Rishikesh, a town infused with cultural depth. He fondly recalled Chotiwala restaurant, a hub of local cuisine, and the spiritual aura of Swargashram, where he captured the essence of a sadhu for his thesis. Rishikesh, also famed for the Beatles Ashram, continues to attract global travelers. Mahindra expresses hope that, despite modern changes, the town's unique spirit remains intact.

description: A remarkable miniature wooden pagoda tied to Empress Shotoku has been sold for an impressive $40,960, shattering expectations. At just 21.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Emma Stone has beautifully transformed a historic home in Los Angeles, which she bought for $2.3 million back in 2019. After completing significant renovations, she listed the property for $3.995 million in January 2024. Boasting a guesthouse, a larger kitchen, and preserved architectural features, the home quickly sold for $4.3 million just ten days later, showcasing Stone’s savvy real estate acumen.

description: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. description: India's Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar won the gold medal in the compound mixed team event at the Asian Para Games on Thursday. The Indian pair defeated Indonesia’s Teodora Audi Ayudia Ferelly and Ken Swagumilang 151-148 in the final. The top-seeded Indian team stayed ahead for most of the contest and held on to win by three points.

description: A 37-year-old man, Biru Singh Bhadauriya, died after being assaulted in Kanpur's Hanumant Vihar area. The attack happened on Tuesday night when he was returning home from a Dussehra fair. His assailants allegedly trapped his hands in the car windows and dragged him for 1.5 kilometers. After the incident, Bhadauriya was taken to Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital where he later died.

This device, intended to help those in rural areas endure the sweltering heat without air conditioning, utilizes a thermocol icebox alongside a solar-powered fan to efficiently decrease room temperatures. Her remarkable invention has garnered praise from industry leaders and she has also showcased her singing talents.

The Indian advanced to the quarter-finals of the USD 143,500 PSA Gold event. Earlier, Singh defeated Nour Aboulmakarim in the opening round. After winning the first and third sets, Swati struggled in the fourth and fifth sets, allowing Cen to clinch the gold. This tournament adds to Swati's recent bronze medal win at the World Archery Para Series.

Simultaneously, US crude inventories dropped sharply, while distillate stocks showed an unexpected increase. Heightened threats to energy supplies from Iran have intensified concerns over shipping safety.

description: In Tripura, a controversial video featuring influencer Amir Shokeen allegedly mocking a tribal youth has ignited political backlash. Leaders throughout the region voiced their outrage, labeling the incident a racial attack and pushing for swift action. CM Manik Saha has directed the Tripura DGP to collaborate with Delhi Police for a comprehensive investigation.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A Kuwait-flagged oil product tanker, M/T Al Dasma, was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers aboard the vessel were reported safe after the incident on October 21. This event follows previous attacks on vessels in the region, raising safety concerns for Indian mariners. The Indian government is in contact with ship management to ensure ongoing security measures.

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In its seventh week, Jailer 2, featuring the iconic Rajinikanth and Mohanlal, experienced a slight dip in box office earnings. The film secured Rs 28.15 crore net in India, accumulating an impressive domestic total of over Rs 300 crore. Notably, the Tamil version highlighted the charts with an earning of Rs 18.50 crore on Wednesday, while its global gross exceeded Rs 582.45 crore.
title: 'Jailer 2' crosses Rs 582 cr worldwide in 7 days, Rs 300 crore in India

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: MrBeast and nonprofit BUILD established five medical clinics using shipping containers across the US, Nigeria, Ukraine and Kenya. The initiative aims to help more than 10,000 people annually by improving access to healthcare. The project addresses emergency care, heart surgery screening, war-related medical needs, clubfoot treatment and free health, vision and dental screenings.
title: MrBeast builds 5 medical clinics across 4 countries to help 10,000 annually

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Dolly Parton’s former West Hollywood home has been taken off the rental market after being listed for $12,000 a month. The singer bought the two-bedroom property in 2007 for $1.2 million, later listing it for sale at $1.4 million in 2014. Records show the home changed hands in 2023 for $1.2 million.
title: Dolly Parton's former West Hollywood retreat listed for $12K monthly rent

author: TNN
description: The disclosure follows a claim by cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse that a threat actor using the name Siriusim had leaked documents and personal data allegedly linked to SBI. The post claimed the dataset contained 3,75,000 rows in CSV files and 2,722 PDF documents, including customer information, loan applications, supporting documents, account-opening forms and addresses.
title: SBI confirms data leak, says 4,000 customer records identified on dark web

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: A senior PCI official, who is part of the Indian delegation in Nagoya and who handled the entire situation, confirmed the development to TOI, describing the alleged misconduct as “reprehensible and intolerable” and saying there could be “no justification” for such behaviour by an athlete representing the country on the international stage.”
title: Sexual offence charge rocks India's Asian Para Games contingent; swimmer faces ban

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The United States ordered some of its diplomats and the family members of US government employees to leave Saudi Arabia late on Wednesday. The move followed a series of deadly attacks attributed to Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels and growing concerns that the conflict could escalate further. The latest violence has raised concerns about the security of Saudi Arabia's critical infrastructure.
title: One killed, 8 injured in Saudi airport attack amid US order for diplomats to leave

author: NAOMI CANTON
description: Senior editor Asra Nomani’s investigation says it has identified 101 organisations across nine countries in a “red-green protest ecosystem” (referring to Islamist and communist groups) that are coordinating, organising or amplifying protests in Europe in an expanding protest ecosystem. Her story also flags how transnational anti-capitalist organisation Progressive International (PI) explicitly grouped the current protests in France, Spain, India and Albania.
title: French riots and Indian protests linked in same ecosystem: Report

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: Will 'Badr MoU' put India’s recent defence agreements with Indonesia on advanced weaponry in jeopardy? Talking to TOI, Sudhir Kumar Mishra, DRDO chair (emeritus) and former director general, CEO & MD of BrahMos Aerospace, said, “Defence agreements with Indonesia have been done with enough safeguards and that only user manual, not technology of transfer manual, will be shared with Jakarta.”
title: ‘Badr MoU’ won’t put New Delhi-Jakarta missile contracts in jeopardy, experts say
